name: Beat Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a haunted drum kit: a bass drum with a stern face, two toms, two cymbals and red plasma arms with drumsticks
entry: Its plasma arms drum faster than the eye can follow. Every beat lands like a punch.
how: Use a Phantom Drumsticks on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Aura Sphere in this form.
